scope: WP5 LUCiD arm objectives, anchor penalty and probe forms, runbook v4 §3.5.6
note: Objective/penalty layer only: no cohorts, checkpoints or trainer. Numerics marked pending_review are frozen by the WP5 config review before any outcome.

sigreg_jepa_anchored_dark.role: secondary R7b: the anchor shown only the dark-noise overlay (draw 1), no per-module rescale

beta.selection_rule: §3.5.6 development cohort: the largest beta whose vertex resolution is <= 1.1 x the development sigreg_jepa (same physics tolerance as R7); one seed per beta
beta.note: No beta is selected here; the grid is registered and build_arm refuses a beta outside it.

ema.target_normalisation: LayerNorm(d_model, elementwise_affine=False) on the target-token embeddings

sigreg.reduction: value = 0.5 * (context-pooled value + target-token value), each the mean over slices of the source N-scaled Epps-Pulley statistic; the source N factor is kept exactly
sigreg.application: context pooled embeddings = mean over the context-view read-out tokens; target tokens = full-input read-out tokens at the hidden (target-view) PMTs
sigreg.status: pinned to the Tier-1 implementation; no new numerics

mae_chi2.covariance: C_m = diag(mu_p (1 + sigma_spe^2) + v_dark + s_p^2 mu_p^2) + s^2 mu_m mu_m^T, over the hidden PMTs of module m
mae_chi2.loss: 0.5 * sum_m (r^T C_m^-1 r + ln det C_m) per event, mean over the batch; Woodbury inverse and determinant lemma
mae_chi2.v_dark_source: dark-charge variance per window from the generator: 4200 Hz * 1000 ns * (1+0.3^2) = 0.004578 PE^2. Not a placeholder: the generator draws dark counts, so C_m stays positive definite at mu=0 for unhit PMTs.
mae_chi2.time_sigma_source: lucid_bombs GeneratorConfig.tts_sigma_ns = 1.5 (reference transit-time spread); converted to 0.015 in the 100 ns token unit
mae_chi2.variance_floor_status: resolved_2026-10-17: v_dark > 0 makes C_m positive definite at mu=0; no variance floor is applied
mae_chi2.variance_floor_note: The reference v_dark = 0 and a hidden unhit PMT has mu = 0, so C_m is singular and ln det C_m diverges. The floor keeps the loss finite but changes the log-determinant term for zero-mean PMTs; reported to the lead as an ambiguity in the registered covariance, not decided in WP5.
mae_chi2.labelled: uses noise-model (oracle) information: the cell's true s and s_p and the reference sigma_spe, v_dark
mae_chi2.status: covariance formula registered; variance floor flagged

anchor.rescale_distribution: per module, per event, per copy: N(1, 0.01^2), the assumed per-module calibration uncertainty
anchor.rescale_domain: recorded charge, applied in the log-charge domain so a unit factor is bit-exact; the hit set is not re-thresholded

dark_overlay.source: dark-noise-only readout windows generated per run (§3.5.3); one independent record per perturbed copy
dark_overlay.charge: add where a PMT is hit in both; the dark charge alone where only the dark window hits
dark_overlay.time: earlier time kept where a PMT is hit in both; the dark time where only the dark window hits

anchor.denominator: trace of the covariance of the module-pooled read-out tokens z_m (B * n_modules samples, d features, unbiased B-1 divisor); the gradient flows through it
anchor.readout: unmasked full-input read-out for z_m(x) and z_m(x~) (Tier-1 pattern)
anchor.status: registered; beta grid pending the development cohort

cell.note: s and s_p are the cell's TRUE spreads, passed per cell at build time; these values are the development cell (s = 0.05) with F3 in force (s_p = 0.10, lucid_bombs.F3_SPREAD).
cell.f3_note: lucid_bombs.F3_SPREAD = 0.10 after the §3.5.3a check; F3 still failed, R12 not_evaluable, no gate

training.optimizer_groups: registered conventions only: Muon for 2-D block matrices inside encoder/predictor blocks, AdamW for embeddings, heads, norms and queries; the EMA target encoder is never in a group. Exposed by LucidArm.parameter_groups; no optimiser is constructed here.

forms_detail.run_mean: features averaged over a run's probe events; R^2 over (run, module), (run, PMT) or runs
forms_detail.propagated: the same probe on the context-encoder outputs at masked positions with the standard training mask; run-mean over events in which the position is masked
forms_detail.raw_input: the same probe on the raw token features (module-mean raw features for module targets); no encoder

probes.run_mean_definition: vertex and log yield are per-event truths, so their run-mean target is undefined and build_probe_dataset refuses that combination; run-mean is the primary form for the registered detector-state targets
probes.grouping: by run (five grouped folds; sorted runs assigned round-robin)
probes.standardisation: fold-internal (fit_ridge standardises on that fold's training rows only)

targets.vertex: (x, y, z), mean over all read-out tokens
targets.log_yield: log yield, mean over all read-out tokens
targets.module_gain: ln gain_m (F1, law T), module-pooled tokens (mean over the module's PMTs), one ridge shared by all modules
targets.pmt_gain: ln gain_p (F3), each hit PMT's token, one ridge shared by all PMTs
targets.f2_variable: F2/F2' variable v, mean over all read-out tokens (run property)
targets.age: r/R (law T), mean over all read-out tokens (run property)

probes.random_init_floor: random_init_floor(arm, geometry, seed=the arm's first seed): the same encoder architecture, untrained; the same probe code runs on it
probes.leakage_hook: probe_predictions + squared_correlation provide R11 cross-leakage; full R11/R11b/R12 evaluation is the evaluation layer's task
probes.status: forms and ridge protocol implemented; the evaluation layer (probe sets, truth assembly from generated runs, floors per arm) is pending
